mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCall, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inbound, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outbound, SUM(CASE WHEN answer_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answeredCount, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 2 AND answer_flag != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abandoned, SUM(CASE WHEN is_ai_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aiAnswered, SUM(CASE WHEN transfer_human = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transferCount, AVG(CASE WHEN answer_flag = 0 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, answer_time, call_end_time) END) AS avgDurationSec FROM call_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND call_start_time >= #{begin} AND call_start_time < #{end}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(call_start_time, #{fmt}) AS label, COUNT(*) AS totalCall, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inbound, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outbound, SUM(CASE WHEN answer_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answeredCount, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 2 AND answer_flag != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abandoned, SUM(CASE WHEN is_ai_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aiAnswered, SUM(CASE WHEN transfer_human = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transferCount, AVG(CASE WHEN answer_flag = 0 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, answer_time, call_end_time) END) AS avgDurationSec FROM call_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND call_start_time >= #{begin} AND call_start_time < #{end} GROUP BY label ORDER BY MIN(call_start_time)

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(number_location, ',', 2), ',', -1) AS province, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inbound, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outbound FROM call_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND number_location IS NOT NULL AND number_location != '' AND call_start_time >= #{begin} AND call_start_time < #{end} GROUP BY province

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(number_location, ',', 3), ',', -1) AS city, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inbound, SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outbound FROM call_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND number_location IS NOT NULL AND number_location != '' AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(number_location, ',', 2), ',', -1) = #{province} AND call_start_time >= #{begin} AND call_start_time < #{end} GROUP BY city

SELECT agent_id AS agentId, agent_name AS agentName, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(CASE WHEN answer_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answeredCount, AVG(CASE WHEN answer_flag = 0 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, answer_time, call_end_time) END) AS avgDurationSec FROM call_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND agent_name IS NOT NULL AND agent_name != '' AND agent_name != 'AI智能坐席' AND call_start_time >= #{begin} AND call_start_time < #{end} GROUP BY agent_id, agent_name ORDER BY callCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT r.route_type AS routeType, c.transfer_human AS transferHuman, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM call_record c LEFT JOIN call_route r ON c.route_id = r.id WHERE c.del_flag = 0 AND c.direction = 2 AND c.answer_flag = 0 AND c.call_start_time >= #{begin} AND c.call_start_time < #{end} GROUP BY r.route_type, c.transfer_human

SELECT direction AS direction, answer_flag AS answerFlag, SUM(CASE WHEN ringing_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ringingCount, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM call_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND answer_flag != 0 AND call_start_time >= #{begin} AND call_start_time < #{end} GROUP BY direction, answer_flag

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN hangup_dir = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS callerHangup, SUM(CASE WHEN hangup_dir = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS calleeHangup, SUM(CASE WHEN hangup_dir = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS systemHangup FROM call_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND answer_flag = 0 AND call_start_time >= #{begin} AND call_start_time < #{end}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, answer_time, call_end_time) < 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d1, SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, answer_time, call_end_time) BETWEEN 30 AND 59 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d2, SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, answer_time, call_end_time) BETWEEN 60 AND 179 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d3, SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, answer_time, call_end_time) BETWEEN 180 AND 299 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d4, SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, answer_time, call_end_time) BETWEEN 300 AND 599 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d5, SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, answer_time, call_end_time) >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d6, SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_time IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, call_start_time, bridge_time) < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s1, SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_time IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, call_start_time, bridge_time) BETWEEN 5 AND 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s2, SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_time IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, call_start_time, bridge_time) BETWEEN 10 AND 19 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s3, SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_time IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, call_start_time, bridge_time) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s4, SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_time IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, call_start_time, bridge_time) BETWEEN 30 AND 59 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s5, SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_time IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, call_start_time, bridge_time) >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s6 FROM call_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND call_start_time >= #{begin} AND call_start_time < #{end}

SELECT DAYOFWEEK(call_start_time) AS weekDay, HOUR(call_start_time) AS hourOfDay, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM call_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND call_start_time >= #{begin} AND call_start_time < #{end} GROUP BY weekDay, hourOfDay

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(call_start_time, '%m-%d') AS label, SUM(CASE WHEN is_ai_first = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aiAnswered, SUM(CASE WHEN transfer_human = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS transferred FROM call_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND call_start_time >= #{begin} AND call_start_time < #{end} GROUP BY label ORDER BY MIN(call_start_time)

SELECT id AS id, call_id AS callId, caller_number AS callerNumber, callee_number AS calleeNumber, direction AS direction, answer_flag AS answerFlag, transfer_human AS transferHuman, CASE WHEN answer_flag = 0 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, answer_time, call_end_time) ELSE 0 END AS durationSec, call_start_time AS startTime FROM call_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY call_start_time DESC LIMIT #{limitNum}
